## Advanced tools for companies of all sizes

Amazon Ads offers technology solutions to help you scale, manage, and report on your advertising activities. Welcome to the advanced tools center, where you can learn more about our advertising technology, how to get started, and how to grow your advertising activities.

[Find the right tools for your business](https://d3a0d0y2hgofx6.cloudfront.net/en-us/_images/pdfs/tool-decision-matrix.pdf)

### Discover Amazon Ads technology

#### Amazon Ads API

Manage and report on Amazon Ads campaigns programmatically through our API.

[Learn more](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/reference/api-overview)

#### Bulk operations

Use bulksheets, a spreadsheet-based tool, to manage sponsored ads campaigns.

[Get started](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/no-code-tools/bulksheets/get-started-with-bulksheets-part1)[Overview](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/no-code-tools/bulksheets/overview-about-bulksheets)

#### Amazon Marketing Stream

Get hourly campaign metrics and notifications of campaign changes in near real time.

[Get started](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/guides/amazon-marketing-stream/onboarding)[Overview](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/guides/amazon-marketing-stream/overview)

#### Amazon Marketing Cloud

Perform analytics and build audiences across pseudonymized signals to address top marketing and business priorities.

[Get started](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/guides/amazon-marketing-cloud/get-started/get-started)[Overview](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/guides/amazon-marketing-cloud/overview)

### Explore key resources

Guide![Image 5: Campaign management overview](https://d3a0d0y2hgofx6.cloudfront.net/en-us/_images/homepage/campaign-management.png)
#### Campaign management in the new Amazon Ads API v1

Use the new campaign management API to create campaigns across different ad products using a consistent campaign model.

[Learn more](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/guides/campaign-management/overview)

Guide![Image 6: Export APIs guide](https://d3a0d0y2hgofx6.cloudfront.net/en-us/_images/homepage/export-apis.jpg)
#### Guide to export APIs

Export APIs offer campaign management information in a common model and format across sponsored ads products. Export APIs will replace the deprecated snapshots APIs. Access our guide to learn more about the benefits of using export APIs and how to get started.

[Download PDF](https://d3a0d0y2hgofx6.cloudfront.net/en-us/_images/pdfs/exports-guide.pdf)

Guide![Image 7: Integration dashboard docs](https://d3a0d0y2hgofx6.cloudfront.net/en-us/_images/homepage/integration-dashboard.jpg)
